sources.entry: WhatsApp Channel Plugin by Richie Liu - Connects WhatsApp as a native Claude Code channel via Baileys linked-device (no bot token or API keys), with bidirectional messaging, full media, voice transcription, remote tool approval, access control, and per-group personalities. Runs entirely locally and was the first community plugin officially reviewed and published on Anthropic's plugin marketplace.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code channel plugin that connects a WhatsApp personal account (via Baileys linked-device) or the official WhatsApp Cloud API to a Claude Code session so you can message Claude from WhatsApp.
summary.what_it_does: The plugin runs a single Bun process that acts as an MCP server for Claude Code. Its default provider pairs with a personal WhatsApp account as a linked device (like WhatsApp Web), and an optional provider uses the official WhatsApp Cloud API for business DMs over a public HTTPS webhook. Inbound messages pass an access gate (pairing codes, allowlists, per-group policies) before being forwarded to the session, and Claude replies with tools such as reply, react, and download_attachment. The README also lists media handling in both directions, polls, voice-note transcription, per-group config.md files with personalities and cron jobs, and permission relay where tool requests are approved or denied with emoji reactions. It also describes catch_up and unreplied tools for recovering context after a restart, a doctor command for diagnosis, and terminal scripts for access management. Other MCP clients such as Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Cursor are supported but are poll-based rather than push-based.
use_cases: Control a Claude Code session from WhatsApp on your phone
Receive and answer WhatsApp messages with Claude
Approve or deny Claude tool requests from a chat app
Transcribe WhatsApp voice notes locally before Claude reads them
Run a business WhatsApp number with Claude via the Cloud API
Set up per-group AI assistant personalities and scheduled tasks in WhatsApp groups
how_to_run: /whatsapp-channel:configure <country code + number> (then enter the pairing code in WhatsApp Linked Devices)
notable: Connects a personal WhatsApp number via linked device, so no bot token or Meta API credentials are needed for the default provider
Inbound messages wake the session as a Claude Code channel when launched with the development channels flag
Access is terminal-only for approvals, so instructions arriving over WhatsApp cannot approve pairings
Permission relay lets you approve or deny Claude tool requests with a 👍 or 👎 reaction in WhatsApp
Per-group config.md files define personalities, memory and cron jobs
caveats: The default Baileys provider uses an unofficial linked-device protocol that may conflict with WhatsApp's terms and put the number at risk
Inbound push requires the development-channels flag; --channels does not accept this plugin yet, and the README notes a known Claude Code client bug affecting message delivery
Only one client can hold a state directory's lock; two connections on the same linked-device auth kick each other off
The Cloud API provider supports DMs only, and Meta fees and messaging policies apply; voice transcription locally requires Apple Silicon
